channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: AI has a millennial cringe problem
item.description: From the people who brought you avocado toast: We millennials are bringing the "chaotic," "unhinged," and other generational-coded words to ChatGPT.

item.title: Read the memo: David Ellison addresses staff as Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. make it official
item.description: Paramount Skydance made the takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery official on Friday, a day after Netflix bowed out of the bidding war.

item.title: It's not just Harvard. The Pentagon is barring troops from attending more Ivy League schools and other top universities.
item.description: The Pentagon is cutting ties with more elite universities, barring active-duty troops from attendance.

item.title: Bill Clinton brushes off '20-year-old photos' in Epstein files and says he wasn't aware of sex trafficking
item.description: Former US President Bill Clinton addressed recently released photos showing him socializing with Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell.

item.title: Microsoft is considering a new AI-loaded software bundle for Microsoft 365, sources say
item.description: The new Microsoft 365 bundle could include Copilot and its new AI agent hub, Agent 365, and could cost $99 per user per month.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth says military support for Scouts hinges on ending 'woke' merit badges
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced the policies of a private youth organization at a moment of high tension in the Middle East.

item.title: Air safety advocates say a GOP proposal won't mandate the collision warning system airline jets need
item.description: A midair crash prompted a bill that would have mandated new anti-collision alerts. Safety advocates say a revised GOP bill doesn't do enough.

item.title: Inside Block's AI push that ended in pink slips
item.description: Laid-off Block employees say they were embracing AI tools in what one called an almost "celebratory" way. Then it replaced them.

item.title: Trump orders federal agencies to stop using Anthropic's technology. Anthropic says it will fight back.
item.description: Trump's directive comes amid a dispute between the AI giant and the Department of Defense.

item.title: Burger King's Whopper upgrade is a high-stakes bet on premiumization
item.description: Burger King announced on Thursday that it will "elevate" its iconic Whopper burger with a premium bun and better mayonnaise.
